reason: Feasibility lens. The OOF retrain is out: fold fine-tunes 'from the public init' are not out-of-fold, and a from-scratch fold retrain of UNet + transformer does not fit ~2 days / ~20 GPU h. The refined plumbing fix (sub-threshold softmax probs p >= 0.05 fed to relink) can be built, but it cannot pass the lab gate by construction, and testing it is expensive. (1) THE LAB HAS NO SUCH PROBABILITIES. Friend A's raw/<stem>.geff is the ILP solution only: 44b6_0113de3b has 25,001 edges, all solution=1, min edge_prob 0.482. So a GPU re-dump is mandatory. Full exp39-style inference (2 seeds x 8-view TTA + edge-feature TTA) runs ~2.5 min/video: ~2.7 h T4 for the 64 SELECTION videos and ~5.6 h for all 135 confirmation videos, 15-30% of the remaining GPU budget. The dump must also reproduce friend A's node ids and candidate edges EXACTLY (different GPU / nondeterminism risk). Otherwise the ckpt, dc/ and divnet/ caches keyed by node id no longer align, and the lab's exact-control property is lost. (2) The relink sits in raw->ckpt, which replay.py does NOT replay. The only path is the relink55/build_t55_cache.py rebuild (199/199 exact at 6.0, local DeepCenter model for new gap points, ~30-50 s/video, so ~1.5-2 h per variant on a CPU kernel). It works, but each BONUS variant needs a full ckpt + divnet rebuild before replay. (3) CONFLICTS: edge['edge_prob'] feeds at least four downstream consumers: the edge filter's p == 0 'unscored' test (probe 29 semantics), short-track rescue (mean prob 0.82-0.88), leaf prune (min edge prob 0.3, exp47/48) and DaughterNet insertion steal_prob_max. Relink edges that were p = 0 and now get p in 0.05-0.48 would silently survive leaf prune and escape ef. A separate relink_prob / ilp_member field therefore has to be threaded through the notebook's filter_output_graph, the ckpt format (src, dst, edge_prob), build_probe_kernel's edgefilter/leafprune/divinsert patches and replay.py. That is about one day of error-prone engineering. (4) EFFECT SIZE VS GATE: with BONUS 1.0, a sub-threshold prob changes a relink cost by < 0.48 um. It can only flip near-ties inside the pockets of ~450 TP / ~340 FP evaluable edges (the swap/diverted FN are node-position errors). The research's own estimate is +0.000..+0.001, below the +0.002 gate. A sparse change like this also hits the 44b6 win-rate wall that stitch hit (15.5%, 59/71 videos unchanged). A test that costs ~1 day + 3-6 GPU h + ~4 CPU h is almost certain to return FAIL. (5) STALENESS: exp51 (coordhead) changes the transformer's inputs (trilinear gather at refined float coordinates) and the node set (-2.9%). If exp51 is adopted, sidecar probabilities dumped on base integer nodes no longer describe the shipped pipeline, and the lab has no coordhead cache to re-measure on. BONUS 1.5 is also the probe-22 direction (0.945 vs 0.947).
fix_if_any: Only as a zero-marginal-cost rider, never as a dedicated run. (a) If a GPU capture pass over train videos happens anyway (the V1284/coordhead head-retrain capture), add a ~20-line sidecar hook at the threshold loop of predict_video, after the seed/bidirectional blending. It writes per-video (t, src_gi, tgt_gi, p float16, p >= 0.05) plus the integer pre-refinement tzyx of both endpoints, with the coord head OFF or in capture/zero mode so the probabilities equal the base network's. (b) Before any lab rebuild, run a cheap CPU pre-screen: join the sidecar to the exp39 edge parquet by integer coordinates (assert 100% node match and that {p > 0.48} after caps equals the cached raw edges), then count the evaluable edges in the u_diverted-zero-prob and ILP-both-none pockets where the sidecar pair's cost advantage over the chosen relink edge is < BONUS x p. If fewer than ~250 evaluable edges could flip (about +0.0019 even if all were fixed), stop. (c) Only if the pre-screen passes: add a relink_prob field used ONLY inside motion_relink_edges. Keep edge_prob / ilp_member unchanged for ef, leaf prune, short-track rescue and divinsert. Rebuild the SELECTION ckpts with build_t55_cache.py at tight 5.5 and BONUS 1.0 only, then run the standard gate. Drop the OOF retrain; probe 29's LB delta is the in-sample audit.
realistic_public_gain: About 0.000 (range -0.001 to +0.001). The lab gate will almost certainly not be passed, so nothing ships; the cost is ~1 engineering day, 3-6 T4 GPU hours and ~4 CPU-kernel hours unless it rides on a capture pass that happens anyway.
